A '''rebel trooper''' was part of the [[4th Squad]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] while the Alliance was based on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] between the Rebels and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Rebel trooper/Legends|trooper]] and a group of three other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], including [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jobin]], [[Grond (Rebel)|Grond]], [[Roj]], and [[Sora]], rallied to defend [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base's]] [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|ion cannon]] from Imperial forces. Two of the troopers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the struggle, and only two made it off Hoth after Jobin was mortally wounded.<ref name="Entrenched" />
